verdict.rationale: Aider's docs say it works directly against LLM provider APIs, including local models with OpenAI-compatible APIs, and do not mention any vendor account login. This implies API-based access rather than account authentication, but no evidence item explicitly documents supplying an API key. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of API key flags, environment variables or config keys for provider credentials, and independent hands-on confirmation of key-based authentication.

support.subject: As a developer, I can authenticate with an API key instead of an account login

citations.quote: Aider works best with LLM APIs
It can also access local models that provide an Open AI compatible API.
Or by setting environment variables like AIDER_xxx
